title: Represent the Animal Friendship higher-slot garble as an unresolved source defect (19.2.1 item 2)
description:
19.2.1 item 2. spell:animal-friendship upcast.sourceCorrection (id ...:text-layer-omission) claims the PDF TEXT LAYER omitted "for each slot" and derives a typed count-per-slot operation from reviewed text restoring it. That claim is false: rendering SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf p. 115 (pdftoppm, 2026-09-23) shows the PRINTED page reads "you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st." -- matching docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/known-source-typos.md. No pinned authoritative source in the repo supplies the missing words, so the typed operation is a silent editorial repair with SRD authority.

SCOPE MEMBERSHIP: exactly one record/clause, spell:animal-friendship higher-slot; the only REVIEWED_SOURCE_BINDINGS entry with a correction (upcast.ts) and the only upcast.sourceCorrection in records.json.

REQUIRED: replace sourceCorrection with an explicit unresolved source-defect representation (upcast.sourceDefect, status 'unresolved', naming the defective printed fragment and the render-verified reason). No typed operation may be derived from a clause carrying an unresolved defect; the printed clause is carried as the model qualifier (disposition typed-core-with-model-qualifier). Runtime source bindings carry the printed phrase and the defect, never reconstructed text. The contract parser rejects a sourceDefect with operations, or whose fragment is absent from sourcePhrase.

NOT IN SCOPE: pinning a second authoritative source (e.g. SRD 5.2) to resolve the defect -- that would be a separate source-authority decision.
notes: PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/568 (head 65fd7098). verify:worktree green (5348 pass / 3 documented skips); verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exact. Stays in_progress until merged.
